a: Raising threshold often increases precision and decreases recall.
Calibration means predicted probabilities match real frequencies.
Ensembles combine models to improve robustness and accuracy.
Bagging trains models on bootstrap samples and averages them.
Boosting trains models sequentially to correct previous errors.
Random forests are bagged decision trees with feature randomness.
Gradient boosting fits new models to residual errors.
Cosine similarity is common for comparing embeddings.
PCA and similar methods reduce feature dimensions.
K-means partitions data into k clusters by distance to centroids.
